title: Module 7 · Lesson 1 — The NVIDIA agentic stack, mapped

lines: Module Seven, Lesson One: the NVIDIA agentic stack, mapped.
Here's who does what.

say.0: Module Seven, Lesson One: the en-vidia agentic stack, mapped.

lines: Picture Leo, a new architect at a furniture retailer, in his first design review.
Colleagues say NIM, Triton, Curator and Customizer; he can't tell them apart.

say.1: Colleagues say nim, Triton, Curator and Customizer; he can't tell them apart.

lines: The fix is to learn each piece's one-line job, layer by layer.
On top sit Blueprints, then the agent layer: the NeMo Agent Toolkit plus frameworks like LangGraph.

say.1: On top sit Blueprints, then the agent layer: the Neemo Agent Toolkit plus frameworks like Lang Graph.

lines: Then NIM serves models, and NeMo microservices run the model lifecycle.
At the base: the serving runtime and Kubernetes infrastructure.

say.0: Then nim serves models, and Neemo microservices run the model lifecycle.

lines: NIM itself is a prebuilt, GPU-optimised model container.
The NIM Operator manages those services on Kubernetes.

say.0: Nim itself is a prebuilt, G P U optimised model container.
say.1: The nim Operator manages those services on Kubernetes.

lines: NeMo Retriever does extraction, embedding and reranking for RAG.
NeMo Guardrails enforces programmable safety rails at runtime.

say.0: Neemo Retriever does extraction, embedding and reranking for rag.
say.1: Neemo Guardrails enforces programmable safety rails at runtime.

lines: Curator prepares data, Customizer fine-tunes, and Evaluator runs benchmarks.
The Data and Entity Stores hold artefacts and metadata.
The NeMo Agent Toolkit composes agents across frameworks, adding profiling and tracing.
Triton is a multi-backend inference server; Dynamo spreads inference across a datacentre.

say.0: The Neemo Agent Toolkit composes agents across frameworks, adding profiling and tracing.

lines: Four boundaries trip people up.
NIM is a packaged, model-specific service, while Triton is a general server you configure yourself.

say.1: Nim is a packaged, model-specific service, while Triton is a general server you configure yourself.

lines: Curator prepares the data, and Customizer trains on it.
Evaluator measures quality offline, while Guardrails enforce policy on live traffic.

say.1: Evaluator measures quality offline, while Guardrails in-force policy on live traffic.

lines: And the Agent Toolkit instruments agents built in frameworks like LangGraph.
It composes them; it doesn't replace them.

say.0: And the Agent Toolkit instruments agents built in frameworks like Lang Graph.

lines: So why is NIM fast?
Its TensorRT-LLM engine brings in-flight batching, a paged KV cache, quantisation, prefix caching and speculative decoding.

say.1: Its tensor R T, L L M engine brings in-flight batching, a paged K V cache, quantisation, prefix caching and speculative decoding.

lines: With an OpenAI-compatible API, switching from a hosted endpoint to NIM is usually a base-URL change.
So agent code doesn't need rewriting.

say.0: With an open A-I compatible A-P-I, switching from a hosted endpoint to nim is usually a base U R L change.

lines: Exam trap: asked why NIM beats a naive Hugging Face server, name those mechanisms, not “it's optimised”.
